title: Aranmanai Kavalan
desc: Sakthi takes upon himself to protect and fight for every Tamilian thriving in Mumbai. When he meets the wife of the late community-chief, he makes up his mind to resolve her family issues.

title: Chinna Marumagal
desc: The eldest daughter-in-law of a family faces various hardships at the hands of her mother-in-law. The youngest daughter-in-law teaches her a lesson and makes her realise her mistakes.

title: Dharma
desc: Intolerant of injustice, Dharma is arrested for killing a man for molesting his sister. Upon his release, he becomes a powerful gangster to fight off evil in society.
